heading: Powers
lead: The corporation has only the powers provided in its bylaws and articles of incorporation filed in each State in which it is incorporated.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 15470636:4002.Apr. 6, 1988, Pub. L. 100–281, § 2, 102 Stat. 73. The words “and subject to the laws of such State” are omitted as unnecessary.
